title: Optimizing map placement increased new-guest bookings

change.control: For search-box queries use Algorithm 1 Bookability Filter map output.
change.variant: Apply Algorithm 2 greedy heuristic to optimize map center for attention to high-bookability listings.

significance.reported: Reported p-value for new-guest uncanceled bookings.

notes: Search-box queries only. New-guest map moves decreased 1.5%, chances of sparse map areas decreased 0.8%; not all-guest booking lift.

verification_details.reason: company, lift and supporting quote confirmed; not a statistical replication
